title: LOCATION!! Walk everywhere Downtown from loft! 409
description:
WALK anywhere DOWNTOWN! This Historic loft is in the Heart of the ENTERTAINMENT DISTRICT! One block from Printer's Alley, Broadway (Honky Tonk Row), and the Riverfront. >>> Newly Renovated with a luxurious Modern Design, high ceilings and exposed brick.

Bed/Room Arrangement:
• Bedroom #1 - Queen Bed, Full Bathroom shared with hall, Walk-in closet
• Bedroom #2 - Queen Bed, Twin Bunk bed, Private Bathroom, Walk-in closet
• Common - Queen Sleeper Sofa

The space
Built in 1910 and just renovated, this Historic Urban Loft in, the landmark Nashville Banner Newspaper building, features a luxurious modern design, high ceilings, exposed original brick, hardwood floors, stainless appliances, granite countertops, large closets, lots of windows and natural light, 50" HDTVs in every room and all the amenities to make yourself at home.
Parking nearby - Secure Wifi - Cable - 50" TVs - Elevator - Secure Coded Access - Private - Luxury Linens and Soaps

Guest access
Guests are provided an access code to the building's secure entry and assigned a private access code to the loft. Secure, Private and Easy!

Other things to note
Beds are dressed in fresh, white, combed cotton sateen sheets and duvets, with down-alternative pillows. All hypo-allergenic. Along with plush, white bath towels, hand towels, wash clothes and bath mats. We've also provided high-quality shampoo, conditioner, body wash and a hair dryer in each bathroom.
